from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,tempfile,zipfile
root=Path.cwd()
archive_path=root/'submissions/인지동_ADE-95_독립뷰어_20261008.zip'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ade95_submission_') as temporary:
    base=Path(temporary).resolve()
    assert base.is_relative_to(Path(tempfile.gettempdir()).resolve())
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        for name in archive.namelist():
            assert (base/name).resolve().is_relative_to(base)
        archive.extractall(base)
    package=base/'injidong_ade95'
    commands=[['src/viewer.py','examples/synthetic','--headless','--output',str(base/'result')],
              ['scripts/verify_viewer_outputs.py',str(base/'result')],
              ['-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-v']]
    results=[]
    for command in commands:
        process=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-X','utf8',*command],cwd=package,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8')
        print('command:',json.dumps(command,ensure_ascii=False),'exit:',process.returncode)
        print(process.stdout)
        print(process.stderr if process.returncode else '\n'.join(process.stderr.splitlines()[-4:]))
        assert process.returncode==0
        results.append({'command':command,'exit_code':process.returncode})
    print(json.dumps({'status':'success','zip_sha256':hashlib.sha256(archive_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'extracted_entrypoint_and_all_58_tests_verified':True,'interpreter':'existing project .venv; no new environment created','commands':results},ensure_ascii=False))
